meta.prompt: Show the plan for migrating my blog as steps: six steps with a short description each. A start button runs them one after another (a second or two each) with a spinner on the running step, ticks on the finished ones, a progress bar and the time elapsed, a pause button, and a summary when all are done.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Blog migration" "Six steps to move your blog" icon:"sync" status:=done==6?"Done":(running?"Running":"Ready") tone:=done==6?"good":"accent" w:390
  state done=0
  state running=false
  state elapsed=0
  state steps=[{"t":"Back up content","d":"Export posts, images and settings.","i":0},{"t":"Set up new host","d":"Create the site and install the platform.","i":1},{"t":"Import posts","d":"Bring over articles, tags and comments.","i":2},{"t":"Move media","d":"Upload images and fix their links.","i":3},{"t":"Redirect URLs","d":"Map old addresses to the new ones.","i":4},{"t":"Switch DNS","d":"Point the domain and check HTTPS.","i":5}]
  every 1500 when running && done<6 -> done=done+1
  every 1s when running && done<6 -> elapsed=elapsed+1
  SectionLabel "Plan" "{done} of 6 done"
  each s in steps
    PlanStep "{s.t}" "{s.d}" index:=s.i current:=done running:=running last:=s.i==5
  ProgressLine "{done} of 6 steps" "{elapsed} s elapsed" value:=done/6
  if done<6
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Start" tone:primary icon:"play_arrow" enabled:=!running -> running=true
      ActionButton "Pause" tone:quiet icon:"pause" enabled:=running -> running=false
  if done>=6
    Receipt "Migration complete" "All 6 steps finished in {elapsed} seconds." tone:good icon:"check"

delta: ps to move your blog" ic
